name: @tormenta20/engine-go
description: Go API + rules engine. `dev` runs air (hot-reload of cmd/api :3001) reading .env.development; `build` compiles the production binary and `start` boots it with .env.production, serving the built SPA, the API and the live stream from ONE process. Production is that single process, in a container: `docker compose up -d --build` from the repo root, database on a host bind mount, and NO reverse proxy — rendered scenes are gzipped in-process by plataforma.Gzip (ALE-273). The WASM is built by the frontend's predev/prebuild.
